name: Priory of the Approaches
description: Priory in Kessig built to house the Seelenstone.

description_citations.text: "Seelenstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Nameless Angel grants the Seelenstone to the Approachers; a shrine, church, catacombs and priory are built for it.
timeline.quote: The Seelenstone was granted to the Approachers by the Nameless Angel to fight the influence of the Bog .

citation.text: "Seelenstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The stone speaks to Willia, telling her to make it whole by finding other pieces among the people.
timeline.quote: It began to speak to Willia and told her of power and that she could use it to stop the darkness.

citation.text: "Seelenstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Willia argues with her parents and, aided by the stone, kills them and turns them into Whisperers.
timeline.quote: She didn't mean to kill them.

citation.text: "Seelenstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Willia begins harvesting souls, killing villagers and betraying the church's occupants.
timeline.quote: she had begun harvesting souls, killing the villagers and betraying the occupants of the church.

citation.text: "Seelenstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Willia breaks the Seelenstone to release its souls for the Bog Entity.
timeline.quote: she broke it to release its souls for the benefit of the Bog Entity.

citation.text: "Seelenstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
